podcast.body: This avant-garde composition famously involves a pianist sitting at a keyboard and performing nothing for precisely four minutes and thirty-three seconds. Despite its conceptual nature, a box set of "covers" by 50 different artists, including Depeche Mode, New Order, and Moby, has been released. "John Cage's avant-garde composition, four minutes and thirty three seconds, which in case you didn't know, involves a pianist sitting down at the keyboard and playing exactly nothing for four minutes and thirty three seconds."
